boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Mercy College of Ohio
boards.description: Ten currently listed Toledo food destinations with late restaurant or drive-thru availability, suitable for under-21 visitors.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Central
cards.subtitle: 3302 West Central, Toledo
cards.notes: Confirm the drive-thru schedule before leaving; the official location page lists service until 5 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A West Central drive-thru with a listed 5 AM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 3302 West Central until 5 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours from 9 AM to 5 AM daily; dine-in hours may differ.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Dorr Street
cards.subtitle: 3149 Dorr Street, Toledo
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the late window; the official page lists it open through 5 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A Dorr Street drive-thru listed through 5 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 3149 Dorr Street until 5 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours from 9 AM to 5 AM daily; dine-in is listed separately.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Reynolds
cards.subtitle: 1317 North Reynolds Road, Toledo
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading over; its official listing shows a 3 AM drive-thru close every day.
cards.short_summary: A North Reynolds location with a listed 3 AM drive-thru close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1317 North Reynolds Road location as open late, with service until 3 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1317 North Reynolds Road, Toledo
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists late hours until 3 AM; confirm current restaurant and drive-thru hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Airport Highway
cards.subtitle: 3460 Airport Hwy, Toledo
cards.notes: Plan for the posted late window and verify the day’s schedule online; the official listing shows service until 3 AM.
cards.short_summary: An Airport Highway location listed open until 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 3460 Airport Hwy location as open late, with service until 3 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists late hours until 3 AM; confirm current restaurant and drive-thru hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Broadway
cards.subtitle: 1422 Broadway, Toledo
cards.notes: For a very late pickup, use the listed drive-thru window; the official page posts a 5 AM close every day.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway drive-thru with a listed 5 AM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 1422 Broadway until 5 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours from 9 AM to 5 AM daily; dine-in hours are listed until 10 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Alexis
cards.subtitle: 2234 W Alexis Rd, Toledo
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to time the trip: drive-thru closes at 4 AM most days and 5 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A West Alexis drive-thru with late nightly hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 4 AM drive-thru closing most days at 2234 W Alexis Rd, extending to 5 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2234 W Alexis Rd, Toledo
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Laskey Road
cards.subtitle: 1859 Laskey Road, Toledo
cards.notes: This location’s official page posts 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru service; check holiday notices before going.
cards.short_summary: A Laskey Road location listed open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 1859 Laskey Road restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru open 24 hours daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Monroe Street
cards.subtitle: 4277 Monroe Street, Toledo
cards.notes: The official location listing shows 24-hour availability; review its current page before making a late visit.
cards.short_summary: A Monroe Street location listed open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 4277 Monroe Street location as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru open 24 hours daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s at 3124 Monroe
cards.subtitle: 3124 Monroe Street, Toledo
cards.notes: Check the official page for the daily schedule; restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Monroe Street restaurant with a listed midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight daily at 3124 Monroe Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru open until 12 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on East Alexis
cards.subtitle: 1410 East Alexis, Toledo
cards.notes: For a later stop, consult the official schedule; this restaurant and drive-thru are listed through 1:30 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: An East Alexis location listed open until 1:30 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1:30 AM daily at 1410 East Alexis.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru open until 1:30 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.
